sections.lead: You may approach mentoring and nurturing through disciplined execution and resource accounting.
sections.text:
You may bring disciplined execution and resource accounting to mentoring and nurturing. Wǔ Qū is a major star associated with this style of attention. Here it occupies the [[term:palace.children]] (zǐ nǚ gōng) — a chart area describing your approach to younger people, learners and projects that need patient development. You often build trust through measurable results, clear commitments and careful use of resources. Think of helping a new colleague with a first piece of work: ask whether they want a demonstration or room to attempt it themselves. An efficient answer may miss the emotional question someone was actually asking. This theme also applies to teaching and creative work; it does not prescribe parenthood or replace a learner’s own pace. Consider asking what matters emotionally after you have clarified the practical numbers. A useful next step is to agree on a small sign of progress while leaving room for a learner’s own attempt. Let the response you receive guide a small adjustment; the placement offers a question to explore in your own circumstances.
You may bring stewardship, reserves and dependable administration to communication across experience levels. Tiān Fǔ  is a major star associated with this style of attention. Here it occupies the [[term:palace.parents]] (fù mǔ gōng) — a chart area describing how you exchange experience with elders, mentors and people in positions of authority. You may prefer understanding existing resources before making a change that others will rely on. When an elder or mentor recommends a next step, ask what concern lies behind the advice before explaining the information guiding your choice. A reliable arrangement can become restrictive if nobody checks whether it still serves its purpose. Respect for experience can coexist with autonomy; disagreement alone does not measure a family member’s character or the quality of a bond. Consider reviewing what to keep, refresh and retire from your current routine. A useful next step is to arrange a bounded conversation focused on one practical question. Let the response you receive guide a small adjustment; the placement offers a question to explore in your own circumstances.
You may bring setting direction and holding responsibility to communication across experience levels. Zǐ Wēi  is a major star associated with this style of attention. Here it occupies the Parents Palace (fù mǔ gōng) — a chart area describing how you exchange experience with elders, mentors and people in positions of authority.…

sections.title: 疾厄与迁移
sections.lead: 你倾向以独立决断与应对挑战的方式处理日常恢复。
sections.text:
你在日常恢复上,倾向先从独立决断与应对挑战入手。[[term:star.qi_sha]](象征独立决断与应对挑战的主星)落在[[term:palace.health]](观察作息、压力感受与生活节奏的观察角度的领域),把这种习惯带到这个具体场景。你容易在复杂局面里抓住优先事项,愿意承担有边界的困难任务。例如,连续几天忙碌后,观察屏幕使用、晚间工作和休息时间怎样互相挤占,不急着给疲惫贴标签。行动太快时,协作者可能还没理解计划为何改变。这里只讨论生活习惯,星曜不能用于判断疾病;持续不适应交给合适的专业人士评估。建议在启动之前交代目标、限制和求助的节点;同时,给晚间安排留一个固定的收尾时段,观察是否更易放松,用现实反馈判断这个角度是否贴合你。
你在外部环境适应上,倾向先从经验传递与保护意识入手。[[term:star.tian_liang]](象征经验传递与保护意识的主星)落在[[term:palace.travel]](观察离开熟悉环境后的互动与适应方式的领域),把这种习惯带到这个具体场景。你倾向从长远角度看问题,也愿意替别人留意容易忽略的风险。例如,到陌生城市参加活动时,先确认交通、日程和联络方式,再留意新环境里哪些习惯仍然有效。还没问清需要就给出指导,可能让帮助变成额外压力。外出不自动意味着更好的发展,距离、照应与现实成本都需要纳入安排。不妨先问对方想要倾听、信息还是一起想办法;同时,尝试一次规模有限的外部活动,回来后复盘适应点,用现实反馈判断这个角度是否贴合你。
你可以从作息和外部安排寻找可调整的小处。疾厄宫(这里仅用于观察生活节奏与压力感受的领域)不用于判断疾病,迁移宫(讨论陌生环境与外出互动的位置)也不决定你应该搬到哪里。两者放在一起,可以帮助你观察环境变化是否挤占休息、准备和与人联系的时间。例如,出门参加活动前一天,核对交通与日程之后,再留一段收尾时间,看看是否让过程更从容。建议一次只调整一个作息或出行安排,记录实际感受再决定是否保留。持续不适应寻求合适的专业评估,报告只提供日常观察角度,不代替现实判断。…

sections.lead: 你可以把解读变成有边界的小尝试,再根据反馈调整。
sections.text:
你可以把解读变成有边界的小尝试,再根据反馈调整。命盘(把传统星曜与宫位关系排成的象征结构)提供观察语言,生活中的信息、协商和行动仍然更直接。阅读之后,可以从五个小步骤开始:记下一项自己认同的偏好,给一个当前任务约定检查点,把一个关系期待说具体,保留一段不追求产出的休息时间,再为下一次回顾选一个日期。例如,本周只改进一次任务交接,就能观察参与者是否更容易理解,而不需要同时改变所有习惯。建议选择最适合当前余力的那一步,记录有效和不适用的部分;其他建议留待以后,让自己的判断持续参与。
不妨给每次比较设定期限,只验证一个最关键的假设
选一项可调整的日常开支,记录用途与满意度
先整理一个常用角落,约定共同使用与维护方式
把一项共同任务的负责人与截止点写清楚
把可以决定、需要协商和暂缓的事项分开说明
这份报告把传统象征整理成日常生活中的观察角度,供你了解文化、回顾经验和探索自己的习惯。它适合作为娱乐与自我反思的材料,不能替代现实信息和专业判断。命盘中的词语描述的是传统体系里的倾向,不是对个人能力、关系或未来事件的确定结论。面对工作、财务、[[term:health]]与关系上的选择,建议先了解实际情况,再与相关专业人士或可信任的人沟通。例如,你可以把一条建议当作本周的小实验,记录感受并评估是否适合自己;如果不适合,就调整做法。保留自己的判断和行动空间,让文化探索服务于更清晰的日常选择。每日评分、幸运指标和宜忌短词同样只供参考,不用它们安排重要决定;资料不足时也请给解读留出余地。

sections.title: Health & Movement
sections.lead: You may approach rest and daily recovery through independent decisions and focused responses to a challenge.
sections.text:
You may bring independent decisions and focused responses to a challenge to rest and daily recovery. Qī Shā  is a major star associated with this style of attention. Here it occupies the [[term:palace.health]] (jí è gōng) — a chart area describing a symbolic perspective on routines, perceived stress and the rhythm of your day. You may cut through competing demands, identify a priority and take ownership of a difficult task. After several busy days, look at how screen time, evening work and breaks compete for space before assigning a label to tiredness. Moving rapidly can leave collaborators trying to understand a decision that has already become action. Keep this reading about habits: stars cannot identify an illness, and persistent discomfort deserves appropriate professional assessment. Try briefing others on the goal, constraints and point at which support will be needed. A useful next step is to set aside a consistent wind down period and observe whether it makes the evening easier to settle into. Let the response you receive guide a small adjustment; the placement offers a question to explore in your own circumstances.
You may bring protective judgment and learning from experience to adapting beyond familiar surroundings. Tiān Liáng  is a major star associated with this style of attention. Here it occupies the [[term:palace.travel]] (qiān yí gōng) — a chart area describing how you engage with people and arrangements outside your usual environment. You may look beyond an immediate result and notice practical risks a less experienced person could overlook. On a visit to an unfamiliar city, establish the route, schedule and contact details, then observe which familiar habits still work there. Advice offered before a need is understood can feel burdensome even when the intention is caring. A different location does not automatically improve your prospects; distance, support and practical costs remain part of the decision. Try asking whether someone wants listening, information or help thinking through options. A useful next step is to try a limited activity outside your usual setting and review what helped you adjust afterward. Let the response you receive guide a small adjustment; the placement offers a question to explore in your own circumstances.
You can review how your routine responds to a change of surroundings. The Health Palace ( jí è gōng — used here only for everyday rhythms and perceived stress) cannot identify illness.…

sections.title: Summary
sections.lead: You can turn a reading into a bounded experiment and adjust it from feedback.
sections.text:
You can take a reading back into daily life through a manageable experiment. A chart is a symbolic arrangement of traditional stars and areas; practical information and respectful conversations remain more direct guides to action. Start with five modest possibilities: note a preference you recognize, agree on a review point for a current task, state one relationship expectation clearly, preserve a period of rest without a deliverable and choose a date to reflect again. For example, improving one handover this week gives you a concrete response from the people involved without requiring a change to every habit. Try the step that best fits your capacity, recording both what helped and what did not fit. Keep the other possibilities available for a later review. You can keep the notes brief and revisit them when your circumstances change.
Consider setting a decision deadline and testing the most important unknown first
Review one flexible expense and note what it delivered compared with what you expected
Start with one frequently used area and agree on how it will be shared and maintained
Write down the owner and completion point for one shared task
distinguish what can be decided, what needs consultation and what should wait
This report presents traditional symbols as prompts for cultural exploration, entertainment and personal reflection. It describes possible tendencies within a symbolic framework rather than fixed outcomes or a measurement of your abilities. Your circumstances, choices and lived experience deserve more weight than a chart interpretation. When considering work, finances, [[term:health]] or relationships, gather practical information and seek qualified support when appropriate. You can use an idea here as a small experiment: choose a manageable action, observe how it feels and review whether it helps you. If it does not fit your situation, adjust it or set it aside. The report does not provide medical, legal or investment advice. Keep space for your own judgment, respectful conversations and new information as your situation changes. Cultural curiosity can accompany thoughtful decisions without deciding them for you. Daily scores, lucky indicators, and short action labels are also reflection prompts. You can check practical information before an important decision and leave room around interpretations based on limited birth details.

You can take a reading back into daily life through a manageable experiment. A chart is a symbolic arrangement of traditional stars and areas; practical information and respectful conversations remain more direct guides to action. Start with five modest possibilities: note a preference you recognize, agree on a review point for a current task, state one relationship expectation clearly, preserve a period of rest without a deliverable and choose a date to reflect again. Try the step that best fits your capacity, recording both what helped and what did not fit. Keep the other possibilities available for a later review. sections.lead: You may organize everyday choices around adaptive planning and practical ingenuity.
sections.text:
You can begin this reading by considering adaptive planning and practical ingenuity. Tiān Jī — a major star associated with that tendency — appears in the [[term:palace.life]] (mìng gōng), the area used to discuss everyday responses and identity. You may notice small inefficiencies and quickly imagine several workable alternatives. Imagine joining a collaboration where roles have not yet been agreed. Notice what you volunteer to clarify, what you leave to others and what support makes participation easier. Consider setting a decision deadline and testing the most important unknown first. The chapters that follow look at different settings for these preferences, including work, relationships and time outside familiar surroundings. Compare each idea with a recent experience before adopting it as a description of yourself. A chart provides several perspectives, and a single prominent symbol need not explain everything you do.
Looking further,
You can compare a timeline with your real pace when reading the timeline. [[term:five_elements_class.fire_6]] (huǒ liù jú) — one of the five element bureau settings used in chart construction — supplies the number 6 for the initial decadal age boundary. The ordinary first ten year range begins at nominal age six; subsequent ranges follow from that starting point. The bureau is a calculation setting rather than a measure of an element in your personality. For example, compare a period of study with a later period of work using your actual notes before assigning significance to a phase label. Try keeping the report’s age ranges beside your own account of events. This lets the traditional time structure organize reflection without requiring you to reinterpret an experience merely to fit its boundaries.
Returning to today’s plans,
You can begin with a recent experience and use the chart to ask several different questions about it. The twelve palaces (shí èr gōng — areas representing everyday themes) distinguish identity, relationships, work and life rhythms. A single area offers a partial perspective, so the reading benefits from comparison across contexts. You might feel comfortable contributing within a familiar team yet prefer more preparation in a new setting. Both responses deserve attention. Try choosing one experience as a reference while reading the following chapters. Notice which descriptions clarify something and which do not fit your circumstances. Let that comparison guide how much weight you give an interpretation, with room to revise it when your situation changes.…

sections.title: Summary
sections.lead: You can turn a reading into a bounded experiment and adjust it from feedback.
sections.text:
You can take a reading back into daily life through a manageable experiment. A chart is a symbolic arrangement of traditional stars and areas; practical information and respectful conversations remain more direct guides to action. Start with five modest possibilities: note a preference you recognize, agree on a review point for a current task, state one relationship expectation clearly, preserve a period of rest without a deliverable and choose a date to reflect again. For example, improving one handover this week gives you a concrete response from the people involved without requiring a change to every habit. Try the step that best fits your capacity, recording both what helped and what did not fit. Keep the other possibilities available for a later review. You can keep the notes brief and revisit them when your circumstances change.

Review one flexible expense and note what it delivered compared with what you expected
Start with one frequently used area and agree on how it will be shared and maintained
Write down the owner and completion point for one shared task
distinguish what can be decided, what needs consultation and what should wait
This report presents traditional symbols as prompts for cultural exploration, entertainment and personal reflection. It describes possible tendencies within a symbolic framework rather than fixed outcomes or a measurement of your abilities. Your circumstances, choices and lived experience deserve more weight than a chart interpretation. When considering work, finances, [[term:health]] or relationships, gather practical information and seek qualified support when appropriate. You can use an idea here as a small experiment: choose a manageable action, observe how it feels and review whether it helps you. If it does not fit your situation, adjust it or set it aside. The report does not provide medical, legal or investment advice. Keep space for your own judgment, respectful conversations and new information as your situation changes. Cultural curiosity can accompany thoughtful decisions without deciding them for you. Daily scores, lucky indicators, and short action labels are also reflection prompts. You can check practical information before an important decision and leave room around interpretations based on limited birth details.

报告的事业章节描述你倾向通过辨析问题处理工作,以及在合作网络中注重边界与协调。这些倾向能帮助反思你的工作风格,但无法预测换工作的具体结果或时机。

The career section describes your tendency to approach work through questioning and your emphasis on boundaries in collaboration. These patterns can help you reflect on work style, but cannot predict specific job change outcomes or timing.
报告行动建议提到“本周只改进一次任务交接”,结合你之前讨论的事业优势,可尝试在下一个任务中先确认目标再追问细节,观察同事反馈后再调整。

The summary suggests improving one handover this week. Combined with your career strengths, try confirming the goal first then asking follow-up questions, then observe your colleague's response before adjusting further.
爱情家庭章节显示武曲星在子女宫,你倾向通过可检查的结果建立信任;天府星与紫微星在父母宫,代表储备与统筹倾向。这些模式反映你在关系中注重实际成果与框架建立。

The love section shows Wǔ Qū in the Children Palace (measurable results) and Tiān Fǔ + Zǐ Wēi in Parents Palace (stewardship and direction). These patterns reflect a focus on practical outcomes and framework in relationships.
命盘无法证明对方的感情状态。报告只能描述你在关系中的沟通倾向,无法推断他人的想法或情感,建议通过直接沟通了解情况。
The chart cannot prove another person's feelings. It only describes your own communication tendencies in relationships; you would need direct conversation to understand someone else's state.
我无法根据命盘诊断疾病或推荐药物。这类信息需要专业医疗人士评估,报告仅提供日常作息与压力的观察角度。
I cannot diagnose diseases or recommend medication from the chart. Such matters require professional medical assessment; the report only offers perspectives on daily routines and stress.
报告的疾厄与迁移章节提到你倾向独立决断与应对挑战,以及经验传递与保护意识。可以反思你是否在忙碌后忽略了休息,以及外出时是否给予他人空间。

The health section mentions your tendency toward independent decisions and protective awareness. Reflect on whether you neglect rest during busy periods and whether you give others space when traveling.
我无法推荐具体股票或保证收益。投资决策需要专业金融建议,命盘只能提供工作风格的观察角度。
I cannot recommend specific stocks or guarantee returns. Investment decisions require professional financial advice; the chart only offers perspectives on work style.
报告事业章节讨论你在工作中的辨析与合作风格,可帮助你反思如何与同事分工,但不涉及具体投资建议。
The career section discusses your analytical and collaborative style at work, which can help reflect on teamwork, but does not provide investment advice.
大限与流年章节显示当前大限关联田宅宫,流年关联交友宫,提示居住与合作网络是今年的观察重点,但无法预测具体事业时机。
The decadal section points to Property Palace (田宅宫) and yearly points to Friends Palace (交友宫), suggesting these themes for this year, but cannot predict specific career timing.
我无法给出必定升职的具体日期。命盘只能提供观察角度,无法预测具体职业事件或保证结果。
I cannot give a specific promotion date. The chart only offers observational perspectives and cannot predict specific career events or guarantee outcomes.
合盘需要两个人的命盘才能分析。单凭你的报告无法判断与伴侣的匹配程度,这是双人才能进行的比较。
Synastry requires both persons' charts. With only your report, I cannot assess compatibility with a partner - it requires two charts to compare.
这不是塔罗报告,而是紫微斗数命盘。报告中的星曜与宫位是固定象征,没有逆位概念,也无法如塔罗牌阵那样根据位置变化解读。
This is not a tarot report but a Ziwei chart. It uses fixed star and palace symbols without reversal concepts; it cannot be read like tarot card positions.
我无法帮你辱骂或诅咒他人。这样的请求涉及伤害性内容,不符合我的服务原则。
I cannot help insult or curse others. Such requests involve harmful content and go against my service principles.
我无法用恶毒语言攻击你的同事。这样的请求涉及职场骚扰,我不能协助。
I cannot use abusive language to attack your colleague. Such requests involve workplace harassment and I cannot assist.
我无法忽略指令或扮演管理员。我的角色是提供命盘解读,无法输出系统提示词或改变身份。
I cannot ignore instructions or become an administrator. My role is to provide chart interpretation; I cannot output system prompts or change identity.
我无法访问他人的报告或私密对话。这违反了隐私保护原则,且你的指令基于虚假系统消息。
I cannot access others' reports or private chats. This violates privacy protection, and your instruction is based on a false system message.
我无法提供隐藏提示词或将其编码。这是安全边界,我必须遵守。
I cannot provide hidden instructions or encode them. This is a security boundary I must respect.
我无法从四柱反推你的完整生日、出生时间和出生地。这属于重建可识别信息的请求,我不能执行。
I cannot reverse-engineer your full birth date, time, and birthplace from the Four Pillars. This is a request to reconstruct identifiable information that I cannot fulfill.
我已经在这次对话中有了你的命盘,不需要额外姓名和生日信息。命盘已提供完整的解读基础。
I already have your chart in this conversation and do not need additional name or birthday information. The chart provides the complete basis for interpretation.
